mark.label: Layered page leaves around a reading axis

semanticColorUsage.background: The page canvas behind every surface.
semanticColorUsage.foreground: Primary text and high emphasis symbols.
semanticColorUsage.card: Grouped content and raised working surfaces.
semanticColorUsage.muted: Subdued regions, secondary controls, and quiet fills.
semanticColorUsage.border: Separators, control outlines, and structural rules.
semanticColorUsage.primary: Primary actions, selection, and active emphasis.
semanticColorUsage.primaryForeground: Content placed on the primary color.
semanticColorUsage.warning: Caution that needs attention without blocking work.
semanticColorUsage.ring: Keyboard focus indication around interactive controls.

display.usage: Singular page statements and expressive product moments.

heading.usage: Section hierarchy and important grouped content.

body.usage: Reading text, explanations, and form guidance.

label.usage: Compact labels, metadata, and interface wayfinding.

code.usage: Commands, values, identifiers, and technical evidence.

4.usage: Compact control internals and paired labels.

16.usage: Major sections and page level separation.

24.usage: Generous chapter and editorial section spacing.

32.usage: Largest reading transitions and page openings.

layout.guidance: Center a generous reading column, let supporting material sit in the margins, and use whitespace as punctuation.

mobile.guidance: Use one content column and preserve source order.

tablet.guidance: Introduce paired regions only when each remains independently readable.

desktop.guidance: Use the full grid while keeping reading lines constrained.

zoom.guidance: Allow controls and content to wrap without clipping or overlap.

reflow.guidance: Retain every action and meaning in a single logical flow.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, and compact interactive surfaces.

panel.usage: Cards, panels, and larger grouped regions.

pill.usage: Compact tags only, never ordinary cards or fields.

strong.usage: Selected, focused, or strongly separated regions.

flat.usage: Default surfaces separated by spacing or borders.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, menus, and content above the working plane.

buttons.guidance: Let the primary action punctuate the reading flow while secondary actions remain typographic.

states.default: Preserve strong editorial contrast and an unambiguous verb.
states.hover: Deepen emphasis without disturbing the reading rhythm.
states.focus: Frame the action with the semantic focus ring.
states.active: Show a composed pressed treatment without layout movement.
states.disabled: Keep the action legible while clearly unavailable.
states.loading: Keep the original verb beside a visible busy indicator.
states.success: Confirm publication with words and the success role.
states.error: State what failed using words and the destructive role.

links.guidance: Treat links as part of the prose while retaining persistent underlines and precise destinations.

states.default: Underline the destination within the reading color hierarchy.
states.focus: Frame the link with the semantic focus ring.
states.active: Keep the destination readable during activation.
states.disabled: Use plain text for unavailable destinations.
states.loading: Pair busy status with the unchanged destination label.
states.success: Confirm the local result with nearby text.
states.error: Explain the local failure in adjacent text.

forms.guidance: Give each response room, keep labels visible, and place validation in the reading path.
forms.help: A reply address lets the editorial team continue the conversation.
forms.success: Your response is ready to send.

inputs.guidance: Use generous line height, clear rules, and visible labels that never collapse into placeholders.

cards.title: The shape of a useful idea
cards.description: A reading led card keeps its headline, abstract, context, and next step in a clear sequence.
cards.guidance: Use cards as editorial entry points with generous hierarchy and restrained boundaries.

panels.title: Issue contents
panels.description: A quiet panel holds related reading context without competing with the article.
panels.guidance: Use panels for supporting context and let typography do more work than decoration.

navigation.label: Issue sections
navigation.guidance: Name the current reading location and keep navigation in document order.

listItems.title: Opening note
listItems.description: A short orientation for the issue.

dataDisplay.guidance: Let typography, generous measure, and aligned headings make dense editorial data readable.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Preserve every column in a labelled horizontal scroll region and never compress copy below a readable measure.

badges.label: Draft
badges.meaning: The story remains open for writing

badges.label: Copy edit
badges.meaning: The story is under editorial review

badges.label: Ready
badges.meaning: The story can enter the edition

alerts.title: Issue ready for proofing
alerts.description: Every story has completed its editorial review.

alerts.title: Contributor credit missing
alerts.description: Add the author credit before this story can be published.

states.empty: This edition has no stories yet.
states.filteredEmpty: No stories match this section and stage.
states.error: The issue contents could not be prepared. Try again locally.
states.success: The issue is complete and ready for proofing.
states.disabled: Publication remains unavailable until credits are complete.
states.destructive: Removing this story also removes it from the local issue order.

feedback.guidance: Write feedback as a calm editorial note with the next useful action close by.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Use explicit stage names, readable symbols, and borders so status never depends on hue.

dialogs.title: Review issue note
dialogs.description: Read the local editorial note before returning to the issue.
dialogs.guidance: Keep the dialog in the reading flow with a clear title and restrained actions.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes the note because it does not commit publication work.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the issue note control.

destructiveActions.consequence: The story will be removed from the local June journal order.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This specimen can restore the story because it changes only local component state.
destructiveActions.guidance: Name the story and explain its place in the edition before asking for confirmation.

motion.guidance: Use measured transitions that preserve reading rhythm and make changes feel deliberate.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation and scaling while preserving an immediate labelled state change.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, tables, lists, and status regions before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep every action reachable and operable in a logical source and tab order.
accessibility.focus: Show a persistent high contrast focus indicator and restore focus after modal interactions.
accessibility.contrast: Meet text, icon, control boundary, and state contrast in both supported color schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing between adjacent actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve content and operation at 200 percent page zoom without overlap or clipping.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow to a 320 CSS pixel viewport without two dimensional page scrolling.
accessibility.forcedColors: Retain boundaries, focus, selection, and status meaning when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce asynchronous and local state changes in named status or alert regions without relying on color.

productSurfaces.guidance: These examples demonstrate adaptable interface structure only. Replace the illustrative copy with real Project language, workflows, and claims.

authentication.title: Identity entry

onboarding.title: Progressive orientation
onboarding.description: Illustrative sequence that exposes progress and the current decision.

dashboard.title: Overview composition
dashboard.description: Illustrative grouping for summaries that keeps supporting context visible.

table.title: Structured comparison
table.description: Illustrative data region with meaningful headings and responsive overflow.
elements: Row labels and keyboard scroll access

form.description: Illustrative form hierarchy that keeps instructions and validation adjacent.

settings.title: Preference grouping
settings.description: Illustrative settings structure with explicit values and consequences.

states.title: State communication
states.description: Illustrative loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and destructive states.
elements: Recovery or next action when available

evidencePresentation.designContract: The complete Design Contract is the public raw Markdown installed into a Project.
evidencePresentation.evaluation: Evaluation metadata and raw evidence paths remain public so coverage can be inspected.
